name: Maine Natural Resource Conservation Program grants

funder.name: Maine Department of Environmental Protection and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (in-lieu-fee programme)

summary: Annual competitive grants, paid from in-lieu fees, to restore, enhance and protect wetlands, streams and other aquatic habitat in Maine. Land trusts and nonprofits lead projects; no match is required.

status.quote: NOTE: The 2026 funding round is now closed and Letters of Intent are no longer being accepted.
The next funding round will open in the spring of 2027.

administered_by.quote: MNRCP is administered by The Nature Conservancy on behalf of the Maine Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers.

applicant_types.quote: Public agencies, non-profit conservation organizations, tribes, and municipalities are encouraged to submit a Letter of Intent for eligible projects.

geography.quote: awards competitive grants to projects that restore, enhance, and protect high priority aquatic resources throughout Maine.

access.quote: Submit a Letter of Intent through our online form to apply for funding.

window.quote: Funds are awarded through an annual competitive grants process.

co_finance_required.quote: No matching funds are required by MNRCP, although proposals that include some matching funds may score and rank better.
